lib/search-params
toList · toPage · toYear · toSort
a hand-edited URL cannot reach the schema
lib/fetcher — the only place an API origin is decided

API_ORIGIN, read from the process at request time
forwards the visitor's x-forwarded-for, so the API's
rate limit keys on them and not on the web tier

drop hop-by-hop headers
forward x-forwarded-for intact
fetch API_ORIGIN + /api/…
30s budget on the wait for an answer, not the transfer

cors · helmet · rate-limit
120/min keyed on request.ip, /health exempt

L2 — Redis
skipped while the circuit is open

a flight already in the air
for this exact key?

toSearchResponse
hits · facets · providers
complete · bounded

do not store it
Cache-Control: no-store
so a retry can reach the providers that failed

ProviderCoverage — who answered, who was skipped and why
complete:false — a source did not answer
bounded:true — every source did, but the rescue was cut short
either one renders as 'total is a lower bound'
